card.name: End point of a range or sequence
card.fires_on: The final item of a range or arithmetic series, such as the 8 in 4.8 in a list of steps, the end month after 'March through', or the end day after 'Wednesday to'.

modes.label: Number in a stepped series
modes.description: The digit 8 in 4.8 inside an evenly spaced list of numbers.

modes.label: End of a date or time range
modes.description: A month, weekday or year that closes a range after 'through', 'to' or 'and'.

modes.label: Year ending a span
modes.description: The last digit of a year at the close of a year range.
